author: CBR
description:
Brendan Gleeson has been cast as Silvermane, and the show is treating him like the main villain of the Spider-Noir series. On top of that, Jack Huston is playing Flint Marko, aka Sandman, bringing a classic Spider-Man villain into the mix. Sean’s take: this is the kind of villain-first Sony approach that works, especially compared to messy crossover teases like Michael Keaton showing up in Morbius.

🎙️ Clip from CBR’s Heroes Journey Podcast – Episode 18.
